name: Cibinetide
summary: Cibinetide is an erythropoietin receptor agonist which is under development for the treatment of a variety of different medical conditions. It was under development for the treatment of depressive disorders, but development for this indication was discontinued. The drug is under development by Araim Pharmaceuticals. Modified derivatives with a longer duration of action have also been developed.

pharmacology.text: Cibinetide (INN; USAN; developmental code name ARA-290) is an erythropoietin receptor agonist which is under development for the treatment of a variety of different medical conditions.

fact.en: Cibinetide is a short peptide copied from one small part of erythropoietin, the hormone that drives red blood cell production. It was designed to keep the hormone's tissue-protecting effects without raising red cell counts.
fact.zh: Cibinetide 是一段短胜肽，仿自紅血球生成素其中一小部分。紅血球生成素是促進紅血球生成的激素，而這個胜肽的設計，是保留其保護組織的作用，卻不增加紅血球數量。
fact.zhHans: Cibinetide 是一段短胜肽，仿自红血球生成素其中一小部分。红血球生成素是促进红血球生成的激素，而这个胜肽的设计，是保留其保护组织的作用，却不增加红血球数量。
